page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.large is a general-purpose virtual machine built on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9T34 processor clocked at 3.4 GHz, configured with 1 physical core presenting 2 virtual CPUs via simultaneous multithreading. Memory allocation is set at 8.0 GB of RAM, yielding a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. The instance includes 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache, along with vector and cryptographic instruction support including AVX-512, VNNI, and AES. The instance features no bundled local storage and requires remote cloud disks. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong single-threaded throughput balanced against constrained multi-threaded execution due to its low core count. The instance achieves top-quartile performance in single-core benchmarks, registering 2006.0 in Geekbench single-core and 3111.39 in stress-ng single-core tests. Conversely, multi-core evaluations place in the lower 25%, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 2501.0, a PassMark CPU score of 3861.67, and software compilation at 2859.0. Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth reaches 47.71 GB/sec and write bandwidth measures 27.73 GB/sec, representing middle-tier throughput. Application metrics include 2.89 million operations per second in Redis SET workloads and 2.73 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

The hardware configuration offers economical resource allocation for single-threaded tasks where per-core speed is critical, avoiding the expense of higher core-count configurations. However, the limitation of a single physical core restricts concurrent data processing and scale. Coupled with reliance on remote network-attached storage, this makes the server poorly aligned with heavy I/O or parallel compilation. Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.large is best matched for lightweight web servers, entry-level microservices, continuous integration build agents, and low-traffic background task processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.large is a general-purpose instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor clocked at 3.4 GHz, delivering 2 vCPUs from a single physical core alongside 8.0 GB of RAM. The instance features hardware acceleration flags such as AVX-512 and AES, a 32 MB L3 cache, and a 3 Gbps baseline network profile. It contains no bundled local storage, operating exclusively with network-attached block volumes. Benchmark testing highlights top-quartile single-core performance, evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 2006.0, while multi-core metrics remain within the lower tier due to the two-thread limit. Memory throughput is average, reaching 47.71 GB/sec for large-block reads. Given its strong per-core execution and low overall resource footprint, the server is suitable for lightweight microservices, API backends, task schedulers, and basic web serving workloads.
